children: Crown Holdings reported 2026 results with revenue of $3.71B, net income of $225M and diluted EPS of $2.08, up 15.9%, 5.1% and 12.4%, respectively, from the prior-year period.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to Crown Holdings”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share attributable to Crown Holdings”.
Nine-month net sales rose to $10.64B, supported by higher material-cost pass-through, 6% higher beverage-can volumes and favorable currency effects.
Americas Beverage sales increased over nine months, but segment income declined amid unrecovered costs and lower Brazilian volumes. North American can volumes grew 4%.
European Beverage segment income rose with higher volumes and operational improvements. Crown plans new capacity in Greece and the U.K. in late 2026 and Spain in 2027.
Asia Pacific beverage-can volumes increased 22% over nine months, supporting higher segment income despite unrecovered utility and transportation costs.
Construction began on a two-line beverage-can plant in Northern India, expected to start operations in early 2028. Brazil’s new line is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
